SRC-002:R0001.text: Detect running agent instances and associate each with launcher, project, process, and native window.

SRC-002:R0002.text: Expose accurate instance count, window title, process ID, launcher name, project name, and running state.

SRC-002:R0003.text: Clicking a project opens a compact rich instance-management panel for that project.

SRC-002:R0004.text: Instance management supports focus, close, refresh, cascade, and tile operations without moving unrelated windows.

SRC-002:R0005.text: Enforce launcher-specific capacity globally; FreeBuff allows one running instance and its launch controls are disabled everywhere with a visible reason.

SRC-002:R0006.text: Monitoring remains truthful when windows close, processes exit, titles change, or a launcher cannot be identified.
